messages:
hema: Heads-up: late EU events for 2026-03-23 04:30-05:15 UTC (~45m). Affects hourly/agg-hours. Need a conservative recompute path that preserves quotas.
taylor: agree on conservative. target shards eu-n1/eu-n2 only, estimate then dry-run then canary. prefer routing to reserved-eu pool if SRE ok.
ben: can we surface token-estimate + expected ETA in the console before run? small UX improvement but saves time.
ux: noted. we'll add inline estimate + ETA on the recompute modal (UX-1321).
sre-bot: SRE notified: request_id=req-20260323-04, awaiting approval for reserved pool.
hema: operator runbook snippet (short):
```
# estimate
POST /internal/recompute/estimate {shards:["eu-n1","eu-n2"], from:"2026-03-23T04:30Z",to:"2026-03-23T05:15Z"}
# dry-run
POST /internal/recompute/dry_run {shards:["eu-n1"], options:{invalidate_prefix_cache:true}}
# run canary
POST /internal/recompute/run {shards:["eu-n1"], priority:"canary", route_pool:"reserved-eu", max_parallel:1}
```
taylor: add guard: auto-abort if estimate_units > 6000 or agg-hours-delta>1.0% on canary. also require `sre_override` header for priority:bypass.
ben: for cache safety add `report_affected_prefixes=true` to run so invalidation is idempotent. persist estimate & dry-run outputs to recompute.audit.
sre-bot: reserved pool approved for this run.
hema: running dry-run now. dr_id=dr-20260323-eu04, simulated_writes=0, affected_prefixes=[tenant:omega/*].
taylor: canary queued rb-12011 (eu-n1). watching agg-hours-delta and token-meter.
sre-bot: rb-12011 success: delta=0.5%, writes=980, units=1890.
ben: ramping to eu-n2 with max_parallel=2. will update dashboard with temporary tile "recompute 2026-03-23 04:30 UTC (EU)" linking est/dr/runs.
hema: after completion, please paste final metrics and close the estimate record. also file a follow-up to improve small-recompute quota metering so reserved pool exceptions are rarer.
taylor: filing follow-up (ENG-750). thanks all. :tada:
